authority: Failed disposable targets are immutable evidence. They were not deleted, reused, promoted, or represented as readiness receipts.

attempts.exact_failure: offline config replacement anchor drift: '  enabled: true\n  force-night:'
attempts.cause: The harness assumed adjacent unlit.enabled and force-night keys although world and buildmode keys intervene.

attempts.exact_failure: TERRAIN FAIL: minimum sampled surface Y -61 gives only -247 blocks above the highest non-Mouth roof; requires 12
attempts.cause: Minecraft 1.21.11's default flat preset placed its surface near the world minimum; the requested Y 200 Mouth could not satisfy buried-roof cover.

attempts.exact_failure: V5 fresh physical install failed: KS01/strips: movable frame set is incomplete: 5/6 unique pieces present

read_only_nbt_diagnosis.root_cause: Displaced-frame recovery used item identity inside a deliberately shuffled movable set. While reconciling the adjacent ks01_lu target it stole the prior target's ks01_lu piece, removed that frame, then replaced the moved item with the next deterministic shuffled item.
read_only_nbt_diagnosis.required_fix: Movable frame sets may never infer target displacement from item identity; a missing movable target remains a blocker rather than consuming a neighboring piece.

attempts.exact_failure: V5 exact book mount install failed: lc_founding_minutes has no safe lectern cell at kept_light_home_01; orin_certificate has no safe lectern cell at orin_marker_6

diagnosis.root_cause: Fallback book-mount depth used the opposite of each fixture's authored front, placing candidate lecterns behind the holder rather than in its public approach space.
diagnosis.orin_observation: All tested rear-side candidates for orin_marker_6 were occupied by the retained stone envelope, so the strict pass correctly refused to overwrite them.
diagnosis.required_fix: Derive fallback positions from positive fixture-front depth while preserving claimed-cell, protected-cell, headroom, and solid-floor checks.

attempts.exact_failure: Failed to download mojang_1.21.11.jar: java.net.SocketException: Permission denied: connect
attempts.cause: The create-only target correctly contained the pinned Paper build but no Paperclip cache. Network-restricted validation could not redownload Mojang's server JAR.
attempts.required_fix: Copy an existing exact read-only Paperclip cache into a brand-new target, record every cache hash, and refuse any byte drift.

attempts.exact_failure: Failed to extract jar files: java.nio.file.AccessDeniedException: cache\mojang_1.21.11.jar
attempts.cause: Initially suspected metadata preservation in the cache copy. Attempt 7 disproved that hypothesis: a byte-only, explicitly user-writable copy failed identically. The durable diagnosis is the command sandbox denying Paperclip's Java ZipFS access to the copied JAR realpath.
attempts.required_fix: Retain exact hash verification, but run the isolated disposable Paper process outside the command filesystem sandbox so Java ZipFS can open the new target cache.

attempts.exact_failure: Failed to extract jar files: java.nio.file.AccessDeniedException: cache\mojang_1.21.11.jar
attempts.cause: The cache was copied byte-for-byte without source metadata and made explicitly user-writable, but the sandboxed Java process still could not open Paperclip's ZipFS realpath. This confirms an execution-sandbox boundary, not byte, hash, or ordinary file-mode drift.
attempts.required_fix: Launch only the new disposable target with the required filesystem access; preserve all safety checks and target isolation.

attempts.exact_failure: V5 exact book mount install failed: lc_construction_surveys has no safe lectern cell at undercroft_seal
attempts.cause: Both undercroft builders faced the fixture-owned mason lectern SOUTH into the seal while the authoritative public approach and LC01 book placement face NORTH. The exact resolver correctly rejected that lectern, and every fallback cell was occupied or protected inside the composed seal.
attempts.required_fix: Face the existing mason lectern from the canonical undercroft fixture front in both builders, reuse it as the exact LC01 mount, and retain all collision, protected-cell, headroom, and standing-lane checks.

attempts.exact_failure: V5 second-pass physical audit failed: AR05/dials item-frame hanging cell blocked; AR05/dials and AR05/reader_control front interaction cells had no floor
attempts.cause: The generic reachability pass preferred a same-height stance for AR05's high stacked dials and reader button. Its synthesized floor occupied a lower dial's adjacent hanging cell, so the first pass created a configuration that the independent second pass correctly rejected.
attempts.required_fix: Treat every item-frame hanging cell as authored physical envelope and prefer an existing room-floor stance up to three blocks below high controls before considering a synthetic platform.

attempts.exact_failure: Five wall signs faced into blocked cells after the complete physical and book passes.
attempts.cause: Compact gate labels were mounted two blocks outside the clear door span. On five gate compositions that position was inside a corridor buttress, so the sign had backing but its player-facing reading cell was solid.
attempts.required_fix: Mount every gate label on the first solid jamb immediately outside the clear door span, audit its front cell during the gate-local pass, and retain the final all-sign world readback.
